game.name: Genshin Impact
game.notes: Version 7.1 'A Rekviem for the Underworld' live since 2026-09-23; 6th anniversary celebrations run through the version.

events.title: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
events.summary: Version 7.1 flagship Moonchase Festival event in Liyue, awarding the event-exclusive 4-star sword Silver Light and 950 Primogems.
events.description: The Moonchase Festival arrives at Yilong Wharf with a story involving Zhongli, Zibai and an old mystery told across the 'A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon' event quest and 'Wondrous Anecdotes' side stories. Three thaumaturge-themed gameplay modes are available: 'The Great Chase and Dispelling', 'Banner Against the Dark' and 'Spiritshot Salvo'. Completing modes and quests earns 'Festive Cheer', which is traded for the event-exclusive 4-star sword Silver Light, its refinement material Tea-Scented Tassel, Primogems, a Crown of Insight and upgrade materials.
events.gameplay: Guide a rattan figure through obstacle courses, clear combat score stages using Banners, and fire Spiritshots at enemy waves; accumulate Festive Cheer to unlock the reward track.
requirements: Complete Archon Quest Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom"
Recommended: Story Quests "Dulciaria Structura Chapter: Act I" and "Tapirus Somniator Chapter: Act I" and event quest "A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon"

rewards.note: per official Version 7.1 event calendar badge
event-exclusive 4-star Sword, unlocked at 200 Festive Cheer
event-exclusive weapon refinement material for Silver Light; exact count unverified

rewards.item: Hero's Wit / Mora / Mystic Enhancement Ore / Sanctifying Unction / ascension & talent materials

events.rewardsSummary: 950 Primogems + Silver Light (4-star Sword) + Tea-Scented Tassel refinement materials + 1 Crown of Insight + Hero's Wit, Mora, Mystic Enhancement Ore, Sanctifying Unction and ascension/talent materials

events.title: Rainbow's End: Resplendent Starlight
events.summary: 6th anniversary gift event: 1,600 Primogems by in-game mail plus a 7-day login check-in with 10 Intertwined Fates.
events.description: The anniversary celebration has three parts: a Crystal Top-Up Bonus Reset, the 'Missive of Grace: A Thank-You Gift' mail drop (2026/09/28 until the end of Version 7.1, each mail claimable for 30 days), and the 'Resplendent Starlight' daily login event (2026/10/01 04:00 - 2026/10/19 03:59). Mail arrives over four days with 400 Primogems each day plus a pet, Fragile Resin, a Sanctifying Elixir and a gadget; the login card pays 10 Intertwined Fates across seven logins.
events.gameplay: Log in to claim mail and check in on seven separate days during the login window to collect each slot.
events.rewardsSummary: 1,600 Primogems + 10 Intertwined Fates + 80,000 Mora + 8 Hero's Wit + 1 Dust of Enlightenment + 2 Fragile Resin + 1 Sanctifying Elixir + Conductor of the "Ya-ho" pet + Mini Trolley Problem gadget (20 pulls total)

events.title: Across the Frozen Wilds, Honing One's Edge
events.summary: Anniversary giveaway: invite one free standard-banner 5-star character of your choice plus their ascension materials.
events.description: A recurring anniversary event that lets every Traveler invite a 5-star character from the standard wish 'Wanderlust Invocation' via the event interface, one invite per account. Inviting a character also grants Ascension Level-Up Materials for that character (enough to raise them to Lv. 60). The pool covers Jean, Diluc, Qiqi, Mona, Keqing, Tighnari, Dehya and Yumemizuki Mizuki.
events.gameplay: Open the event interface and select one character to invite permanently to your roster.

rewards.note: choice of Jean, Diluc, Qiqi, Mona, Keqing, Tighnari, Dehya or Yumemizuki Mizuki
materials to raise the invited character to Lv. 60

events.rewardsSummary: 1 free standard 5-star character of your choice + Lv. 60 ascension and level-up materials

events.title: Tabletop Troupe: A Gathering on Adventure's Eve
events.summary: Anniversary event giving one free limited-event 5-star character from a set pool, unlocked after the 7.1 Archon Quest.
events.description: A tabletop-roleplaying-themed anniversary event in which the Traveler gathers the Tabletop Troupe. It awards a free event-exclusive 5-star character from a fixed pool - Tartaglia, Nilou, Baizhu, Chiori, Clorinde or Varesa - together with the materials needed to raise them to Lv. 60. The invite only unlocks after completing the Version 7.1 Archon Quest, so it pairs with the 'A Rekviem for the Underworld' story event.
events.gameplay: Progress the event's tabletop adventure, then claim one permanent 5-star character invite from the event interface.
requirements: Complete the Version 7.1 Archon Quest "A Rekviem for the Underworld" (Chapter VII: Act IV)

rewards.note: choice of Tartaglia, Nilou, Baizhu, Chiori, Clorinde or Varesa
materials to raise the invited character to Lv. 60

events.rewardsSummary: 1 free limited-event 5-star character (Tartaglia, Nilou, Baizhu, Chiori, Clorinde or Varesa) + Lv. 60 ascension and level-up materials

events.title: Complete Archon Quest "A Rekviem for the Underworld" Within the Specified Duration
events.summary: Time-limited completion bonuses for finishing Archon Quest Chapter VII Acts III and IV during Version 7.1.
events.description: Archon Quest Chapter VII: Act III "White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking" and Act IV "A Rekviem for the Underworld" became permanently available with the Version 7.1 update. Completing them within the specified duration grants additional Primogems, Character Ascension Materials, Character Level-Up Materials and Snezhnaya regional specialties. Finishing Act IV in time also unlocks a time-limited Epilogue quest for the series.
events.gameplay: Follow the Snezhnaya Archon Quest storyline and complete Acts III and IV before the deadline to receive the bonus rewards in mail.
requirements: Complete Archon Quest Chapter VII: Act II "Wraith's Nocturne"

rewards.note: Archon Quest Acts III+IV total including the time-limited completion bonus, per the Version 7.1 Special Program; exact split not published

events.rewardsSummary: 620 Primogems (quest + completion bonus per the 7.1 Special Program) + character ascension materials + character level-up materials + Snezhnaya regional specialties

events.title: Anniversary Memories Album
events.summary: 6th anniversary web event looking back at your Teyvat journey, giving up to 180 Primogems.
events.description: A browser-based 6th anniversary event in which Paimon looks back on your journey through Teyvat. It features three main activities that flip through a memories album of your account history, with rewards claimed from a chest icon on the event screen. It also includes a theme song sung by Childe's English voice actor.
events.gameplay: Open the web event page, browse the three album activities and claim the reward chest.

rewards.note: total per the official event notice; the official 7.1 calendar badge shows 150, discrepancy unverified

events.rewardsSummary: 180 Primogems
events.sourceName: GenshinBuilds (citing the official web event notice)

events.title: Starlit Gala (Miliastra Wonderland)
events.summary: Anniversary celebration around the Miliastra Wonderland UGC mode, with Primogems, Geodes of Replication and cosmetics across two reward phases.
events.description: The Starlit Gala is the reward track of the Miliastra Wonderland anniversary celebration. Special event gifts unlock from September 23, including the free Headwear 'Unusual Hilichurl Mask' and the 'Phantom Night Candlelight' Event Ode. From October 1 the two reward tracks open: the in-game 'Starlit Gala: Wonderland Selects' event (Phase 1 10/01-10/22, Phase 2 10/22-11/03) pays Primogems, a Prismatic Crystal, a Geode of Replication, the Cryo Slime Hat and four expressions; the web page track pays Primogems, another Geode of Replication and more cosmetics. Version 7.1's Event Ode 'Moonlight After the Rain' separately carries the Legendary 5-star cosmetic set 'Osmanthus in the Moonlight'.
events.gameplay: Play Miliastra Wonderland (UGC) activities and the Starlit Gala web page minigames to progress both reward tracks.

rewards.note: official 7.1 calendar badge covering both phases; per-phase vs total unclear
one per reward track (in-game event + web page)

rewards.item: Cosmetics (Unusual Hilichurl Mask headwear, Cryo Slime Hat, Osmanthus Retreat Moon Lamp, expressions Big Thumbs-Up!/Delicate Heart/V for Victory/Crafting with Care/Hands Up in the Air/In Perfect Sync/Giggle)

events.rewardsSummary: 20 Primogems (calendar badge, per-phase vs total unclear) + 2 Geodes of Replication + 1 Prismatic Crystal + cosmetic set (Unusual Hilichurl Mask, Cryo Slime Hat, Osmanthus Retreat Moon Lamp and 7 expressions)

events.title: Stygian Onslaught
events.summary: Ley-line-disturbance boss challenge with three consecutive boss fights and a 450 Primogem reward track.
events.description: The September/October 2026 cycle of Disturbance-affected Ley Line challenges. Travelers fight three consecutive bosses - Battle-Hardened Domovoy Sculptor: Gale Hewing, Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply and Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: Endless Reverberation - across six difficulty levels. Clearing Normal, Advancing and Hard difficulty covers the full 450-Primogem reward track; the upper difficulties add Dust of Enlightenment and Radiant Phantasm challenge rewards. The Disturbance Outbreak artifact-farming window runs only through October 10.
events.gameplay: Build teams and clear three consecutive boss encounters at rising difficulty; during Disturbance Outbreak, Hard+ clears let AR 45 players spend Resin on a selected Domain of Blessing while building Dire Prestige.
requirements: Adventure Rank 45+ for the Disturbance Outbreak artifact farming (Hard or above)

rewards.note: full reward track for Normal/Advancing/Hard clears
upper difficulty reward, amount not published

events.rewardsSummary: 450 Primogems + Dust of Enlightenment + Radiant Phantasm challenge rewards (upper difficulties)

events.title: Event Wish "When Warm Winds Cavort"
events.summary: Version 7.1 Phase I Character Event Wish debuting Vesna (Anemo Sword, 5-star).
events.description: Character Event Wish featuring the debut of 5-star 'Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade' Vesna, an Anemo Sword user and commander of the Druzhna who enables Stellar Swirl reactions. The boosted 4-star characters are Diona (Cryo), Faruzan (Anemo) and Chongyun (Cryo). The parallel Epitome Invocation weapon banner features the 5-star weapons Beyond the Chrysalis (Sword) and Hymn of the Maelstrom (Catalyst).
events.gameplay: Spend Intertwined Fates on the limited character wish; Test Run trial stages with the featured characters are open during the banner.
requirements: Adventure Rank 5 or above (Wish feature unlocked)

rewards.note: small material rewards for clearing the trial stages; amounts not published

events.title: Predictive Victory Dynamics
events.summary: Combat prediction event in Natlan betting on simulated fights, with a 420 Primogem reward track.
events.description: Back in the home of Natlan's Children of Echoes, elite warrior Liliuo and Fatui operative Wislawa are using a combat simulator to model the odds of victory. Travelers place bets on which side will win each of 16 simulated fights, earning points and rewards based on the outcomes. The official event calendar also shows an Announcement Period running to 2026-10-23 after the event ends.
events.gameplay: Study the two combatant line-ups, place your bet on the predicted winner of each simulated battle, and collect points for correct calls.
events.rewardsSummary: 420 Primogems + Sanctifying Unction + Adventurer's Experience + Mora + weapon ascension materials
events.sourceName: timesaver.gg (transcribed from official Version 7.1 Event Calendar, HoYoLAB post 46673425)

events.title: Carefree Snowball Fight
events.summary: Four-player co-op snowball fight in the Snezhnaya snowfields with a 420 Primogem reward track.
events.description: In the snowfields southwest of Morespok, a group of children led by the Frost Operative is having a snowball fight - and the Traveler joins in. Players team up in co-op, chucking snowballs at Oddowls to rack up the highest score possible; the higher the total score each round, the better the rewards, including Primogems, Mora and level-up materials.
events.gameplay: Play 4-player co-op snowball rounds, hitting Oddowls and opponents to build the team's total score per round.
events.rewardsSummary: 420 Primogems + character talent materials + Sanctifying Unction + Hero's Wit + Mora + weapon ascension materials

events.title: Overflowing Favor
events.summary: Double artifact drop event - claim double domain artifact drops a set number of times per day.
events.description: A short farming event with no Primogem reward: for one week, spending Original Resin in artifact domains yields double artifact drops, claimable a set number of times per day (three double-drop claims per day per current guides). It is the fastest way to farm artifacts during Version 7.1.
events.gameplay: Spend Original Resin in artifact domains to receive double drops, up to three claims per day.

rewards.note: 3 double-drop claims per day; no Primogems per the official event calendar

events.rewardsSummary: Double artifact drops from domains 3x per day (no Primogems)

events.title: Great Expeditionist Challenge
events.summary: Version 7.0 flagship event - exploration and challenge competition awarding a free Diona and 920 Primogems.
events.description: The Version 7.0 flagship event in Snezhnaya: 'Compete to Invite Diona!' Travelers took on expedition-style exploration and combat challenges across the new region, earning event currency and rewards. Completing the event challenges let players permanently invite the 4-star Cryo character Diona and earn a Crown of Insight alongside Primogems and materials.
events.gameplay: Complete rotating exploration and combat challenge stages to accumulate event progress and claim the invite and reward track.

rewards.note: total across the event per third-party reward tables

events.rewardsSummary: 920 Primogems + free Diona (4-star Cryo) + 1 Crown of Insight + upgrade materials

events.title: Trial of the Bastion
events.summary: Firearms-based base defense event with 420 Primogems, ended 2026-09-17.
events.description: A Version 7.0 combat event that put firearms in the Traveler's hands as the primary mechanic: defend a bastion against waves of opponents using guns and turrets. A new trial unlocked each day for the first five days, each with its own challenge rating target (for example clearing all three waves of Stage III with a 4,500 rating for the full 80 Primogems).
events.gameplay: Clear daily-unlocking defense trials using the firearm mechanic and hit the challenge rating thresholds for full rewards.
requirements: Complete Archon Quest Prologue: Act III "Song of the Dragon and Freedom"
Complete the "Gunfire in the Silent Lands" quest from Chapter VII: Act I

rewards.note: total across stages (80 per stage max)

events.title: Overflowing Abundance (Ley Line Overflow)
events.summary: Double-reward farming event for Domains of Mastery and Domains of Forgery, ended 2026-09-21.
events.description: A recurring Ley Line Overflow style farming event: successfully challenging Domains of Mastery or Domains of Forgery and consuming Original Resin doubled the rewards, up to three times per day. It was the best-value Resin week of Version 7.0 for talent books and weapon ascension materials ahead of the 7.1 character releases.
events.gameplay: Spend Original Resin on Domains of Mastery (AR 25+) or Domains of Forgery (AR 15+) to receive double drops, three claims per day.
events.rewardsSummary: Double talent-book and weapon-ascension drops from domains, up to 3x per day (no Primogems)
events.sourceName: timesaver.gg (citing the in-game announcement feed, announcement 20888)
